parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is optional if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK/SK) or an STS token.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can obtain this ID from your organization's URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
